SECTION 01

Getting started

What you need before you log in, and what you'll see the first time you do.

What you need

  1. Any modern web browser. Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge — all work. Nothing to install.
  2. An Instagram Business or Creator account, OR a Facebook Page. That's the only account you need to sign in with — Kakoi creates your workspace from that login. Instagram Business accounts authorize through Facebook's screen; that's Meta's design, not a misstep.
  3. About 60 seconds for the first-time sign-in + onboarding.
📌
No keys, no installs, no servers. Kakoi handles the AI, the OAuth tokens, and all the heavy lifting behind the scenes. You just sign in.

Step 1 — Sign in

The sign-in screen has two buttons: Continue with Facebook and Continue with Instagram. Pick whichever matches the brand you publish from.

  • Continue with Facebook — best if you primarily post on Facebook Pages, or if your Instagram is already linked to a Facebook Page (most are).
  • Continue with Instagram — same flow under the hood; you'll see a Facebook authorization page because Instagram Business accounts authorize through Facebook. That's correct.

Approve the permissions, and Kakoi redirects you back. Your session is now active.

The sign-in screen. Two buttons; both routes go through Facebook's authorization page.

Step 2 — Let Kakoi learn your niche

Before you do anything, Kakoi reads your last 20 posts from your Instagram + Facebook account and asks one question:

"Does this look right? You make English-teaching content, mostly in English, with a clear, encouraging tone."

This is the onboarding wizard — a 3-step modal that runs once, on first sign-in:

  1. Confirm the detected niche. Click "Yes, that's me" if Kakoi got it right — or "Not quite — let me adjust" to pick the niche manually.
  2. (If you adjusted) Pick interest tags. Choose up to 6 — e.g. grammar, vocab, pronunciation. Kakoi uses these to boost matching trends in your feed.
  3. Optional — describe your voice. One sentence, e.g. "casual, no jargon, one emoji per post." Kakoi feeds this into every caption it generates.

Click Get started. The wizard dismisses, and your Content tab is seeded with RSS feeds matched to your niche.

Step 1 of the onboarding wizard. Confidence score tells you how sure Kakoi is about the detected niche.

Step 3 — First launch

You land on the Content tab — that's home. The side rail on the left has your 9 sections; hover any icon to see its label, click to switch tabs. On mobile, the same icons appear as a bottom dock.

The Content tab is your home base. After your first scrape it fills with cards like these.

The five-minute first run

  1. Go to ⚙️ Settings — top-right of the tab bar.
  2. Open the Platforms sub-tab — confirm at least one platform shows Connected.
  3. Switch back to 📡 Content and click the Scrape RSS button.
  4. Wait ~30 seconds. Kakoi pulls articles from its 14 default RSS feeds, scores them with AI, and lays them out in the gallery.
  5. Click any card to expand it. You'll see the AI-generated caption, hashtags, and a publish button.
✅
You did it. That's the full loop: discover → generate → review → publish. Every other feature in this guide is something that makes one of those four steps better, faster, or more automatic.

SECTION 03

Discovering content

Three ways to find something worth posting about — Kakoi covers all of them.

Option A — RSS scraping (the default)

Kakoi ships with 14 default RSS feeds across news, culture, and trending topics. You can scrape all of them in one click from the Content tab.

  1. Go to 📡 Content.
  2. Click Scrape RSS in the top-left. The button shows a spinner while it works.
  3. Wait for results. Kakoi pulls fresh articles, AI-scores them for relevance, and displays them in the gallery. Each card shows the source, category, and score.
  4. Filter the results using the search bar, source dropdown, and category pills above the gallery.
The Content gallery after a fresh scrape. Each card is an AI-scored article ready to become a post.

Option B — Paste a URL

Found an article elsewhere? Use the URL → Post tab.

  1. Go to 🔗 URL → Post.
  2. Paste the article URL into the text field.
  3. Press Enter or click Generate. Kakoi fetches the article, extracts the meaningful content, and generates a caption.
  4. The result appears below. You can edit before publishing or saving.
Paste any article URL — Kakoi extracts the content and drafts a post for you.

Option C — Trends

The Trends tab aggregates trending topics from Twitter, Google, Reddit, and news sources. It's where you go when nothing is scheduled and you need an idea fast.

  1. Go to 🔥 Trends.
  2. Browse the list — topics are sorted by heat score within each source.
  3. Filter by source or category using the pill row.
  4. Click Create Post next to any trend to start drafting around that topic.
Trending topics in one place. Each row links straight to post creation.
💡
Tip — add your own RSS feeds. You're not stuck with the defaults. Settings → RSS Sources lets you add any feed URL. Add 5-10 niche feeds for your category and watch the gallery get more relevant week by week.
SECTION 04

Generating posts with AI

The AI does the heavy lifting for captions, images, hashtags, and even carousels — but you're always in control.

Click a card to expand it

Inside the Content gallery, every card is collapsed by default — small image, short title. Click anywhere on a card to expand it. The expanded view shows the full toolbar.

An expanded card. The full set of action buttons becomes available.

The action buttons explained

ButtonWhat it doesWhen to use it
📷 New photoPulls a fresh image from Pexels using an LLM-generated search query for this article.The default photo doesn't fit the vibe.
✍️ Regenerate textGenerates a new AI caption (and hashtags) for this article.You want a different angle or tone.
🔄 Regenerate allRe-runs both: new photo and new caption.Start from scratch on this article.
✏️ EditEdit the caption inline. Click Done to save.Small tweak rather than full regenerate.
🎯 VoiceRuns the caption through Brand Voice validation. Returns a score + suggestions.Before publishing, on important posts.
🌐 LangGenerates the same caption in English, Japanese, French, or any language.Posting to an international audience.
🧪 A/BGenerates two caption variants from the same article. Saves them as an A/B test.Launch posts, product announcements.
🔗 ShortShortens the article link via Kakoi's built-in shortener.Tight character limits, Twitter/Threads.
📤 PublishPublishes to selected platforms in parallel.Ready to go live now.
📅 CalendarSchedules instead of publishing now.You want to post at the optimal time later.

Generating a carousel

Carousels are multi-slide posts (Instagram, Facebook). Kakoi generates them with the LLM and lets you reorder slides via drag-and-drop.

  1. Expand a card in the Content tab.
  2. Click the Carousel button in the toolbar. Kakoi generates 5-8 slides, each with its own image and slide title.
  3. Drag any slide to reorder. The first slide is your cover.
  4. Edit slide titles inline if you want to tweak wording.
  5. Click Publish when satisfied.
SECTION 05

Refining and customizing

Brand voice validation, A/B testing, image editing, multi-language. The polish layer.

Brand Voice validation

Define your brand guidelines once, then validate every caption against them automatically.

  1. On any expanded card, click 🎯 Voice.
  2. Kakoi sends the caption to the LLM along with your brand guidelines.
  3. You get back a score (0-100) and a list of concrete suggestions ("Too formal — try a more conversational opener", etc.).
  4. Apply the suggestions by editing the caption manually, or hit Regenerate to try again.
📌
Set your brand voice once. The guidelines live in Settings → Templates. Spend 10 minutes describing your tone — formal vs. casual, vocabulary, emoji usage, sentence length — and every future Voice check will use those rules.

A/B testing captions

Don't guess which caption works better. Generate two and compare.

  1. On an expanded card, click 🧪 A/B. Kakoi generates two caption variants from the same article.
  2. Both variants are saved in Settings → A/B Tests.
  3. Publish each variant separately (different posts, different days) and track which one performs.
  4. Return to Settings → A/B Tests and click Pick A, Pick B, or Tie to record the winner.
A/B tests in Settings — side-by-side comparison with winner highlighting.

Multi-language captions

One click generates the same post in multiple languages.

  1. On any expanded card, click 🌐 Lang.
  2. Kakoi generates the caption in English, Japanese, and French by default (configurable).
  3. Pick which language to publish in this post — the others stay available for separate posts targeting different audiences.

Image editing

Kakoi includes a canvas-based image editor for cropping, filtering, and adding text overlays — no Canva trip required.

  1. Hover over the image in an expanded card. An ✏️ Edit Image button appears in the top-right corner.
  2. Click it to open the editor modal.
  3. Crop, apply filters, or add text overlays. All changes are non-destructive — you can hit Reset.
  4. Click Save to persist the edited version back to this post.
SECTION 06

Publishing & scheduling

One click to fan out across four platforms. Or schedule it for later.

Publishing now to multiple platforms

  1. On the expanded card, look at the Publish to platforms row. Each connected platform shows as a pill.
  2. Toggle the platforms you want to publish to. Greyed-out pills mean that account isn't connected yet.
  3. Click 📤 Publish. The number in parentheses tells you how many platforms will receive this post.
  4. Kakoi shows a per-platform status indicator as each platform confirms.
💡
Platform-specific caption length warnings. If Threads is selected and your caption is over 500 characters, Kakoi flags it with a yellow warning. Same for TikTok's 2,200 limit. You can publish anyway (Kakoi will auto-truncate where supported) or shorten manually first.

Scheduling instead of publishing now

  1. On the expanded card, click 📅 Calendar instead of Publish.
  2. Pick a date and time in the modal.
  3. Choose status — Draft (you'll review again) or Scheduled (auto-publishes at the chosen time).
  4. Click Create. The post now appears in the Calendar tab.

The Calendar tab

The Calendar tab is your schedule overview — drag-and-drop, multi-platform per slot, iCal export.

The Calendar tab. Each colored bar is a scheduled post — click to edit, drag to reschedule.
  1. Click any event to open it for editing.
  2. Drag an event to a different day to reschedule.
  3. Toggle Month / Week views in the top-right.
  4. Export to iCal with the Export iCal button — pipe your Kakoi schedule into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Notion.
  5. Click + New Event to manually create a scheduled post without going through the gallery.
SECTION 07

Automating with Autopilot

Set guardrails once. Walk away. Wake up to published content.

Autopilot runs the full Kakoi pipeline — scrape, score, generate captions, generate images, queue, publish — on a schedule, within your rules. You can find it inside the Calendar tab.

Autopilot expanded. The sliders are your guardrails.

Setting up Autopilot

  1. Go to 📅 Calendar.
  2. Click the Autopilot panel at the top to expand it.
  3. Set Max Posts/Day — a hard cap. Start at 1-2 while you build trust; raise it once you're sure the output is good.
  4. Set Min Score — only articles scoring at or above this threshold get processed. 7 is a sensible default.
  5. Set Interval (hours) — how often Autopilot wakes up to scrape. 6 hours is a good rhythm.
  6. Choose platforms — toggle which accounts Autopilot publishes to. Many creators run Autopilot for IG + FB only and post to TikTok/Threads manually.
  7. Toggle Auto-publish — if ON, Autopilot publishes automatically. If OFF, posts just queue as drafts for you to review.
  8. Click Start. The status pill flips from Stopped to Running.
⚠️
Don't turn on Auto-publish on day one. Run Autopilot with Auto-publish OFF for a week first. Review the drafts it queues. Adjust your RSS sources, min score, or brand voice template based on what you see. Turn Auto-publish ON only when you trust the output.

What Autopilot does, in order

  1. Wakes up on schedule. Every X hours per your interval setting.
  2. Scrapes RSS feeds. Pulls fresh articles.
  3. Scores articles. The LLM rates each one 0-10 for relevance and quality.
  4. Filters. Drops anything below your min score or outside allowed categories.
  5. Generates captions and images. Same as if you clicked Regenerate all manually.
  6. Either publishes or queues, depending on your Auto-publish toggle.
  7. Updates status. Last run, next run, posts today — all visible in the panel.

Monitoring Autopilot

The Autopilot panel header shows live status: Running/Stopped, last run timestamp, next scheduled run, and posts published today. If anything goes wrong, you'll see error pills.

💡
Stop Autopilot before big events. If you're launching something or going on vacation, hit Stop. Autopilot can be paused and resumed without losing config.
SECTION 08

Engaging with comments

Aggregated inbox across platforms with AI-drafted replies tuned to your voice.

The Comments tab — unified inbox across your configured platforms.

How to use the Comments tab

  1. Go to 💬 Comments.
  2. Pick a post from the left-side list. Posts are sorted by recent activity.
  3. Read the comments on the right, grouped by sentiment (positive, negative, neutral).
  4. Click Suggest Reply on any comment. Kakoi generates a reply in your brand voice.
  5. Edit if needed — the suggestion is a starting point, not a mandate.
  6. Click Send to post the reply.
📌
Sentiment scoring tells you where to focus. Sort by negative sentiment first — that's where you most need a human voice. Positive comments can often get a quick "thank you" reply or a heart, AI-suggested.
SECTION 09

Measuring performance

Five metric cards, two charts, one heatmap. And recommendations that tell you what to do next.

The Analytics dashboard. Five metric cards at the top, trend chart below.

Reading the dashboard

  1. Go to 📊 Analytics.
  2. Pick your platform in the top row — Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, or All.
  3. Pick a date range — 7d, 30d, 90d, or all.
  4. Read the metric cards: Total Reach, Avg Engagement %, Likes, Saves, Comments. Each has a trend arrow comparing to the prior period.
  5. Scroll down for the engagement chart — bar chart of your last 7 posts, color-coded by performance vs. your average.

Optimal posting time

Below the main metrics is a 7×24 heatmap showing when your audience engages most. Darker squares = higher engagement.

  1. Scroll to the Posting Time Heatmap section in the Analytics tab.
  2. Find the darkest cells. Those are your optimal slots.
  3. Read the Best Posting Time card — Kakoi summarizes the heatmap into a single recommended day + hour.
  4. Schedule your next post at that time via the Calendar tab.

Content recycling

Kakoi finds high-performing posts older than 90 days that are worth re-sharing.

  1. In the Analytics tab, find the Recyclable Posts section (usually mid-page).
  2. Browse the list — Kakoi shows the original post, its metrics, and a suggested re-share.
  3. Click Re-share to duplicate the post into a new draft, ready to publish or schedule.

Hashtag strategy

The Hashtags section in Analytics shows which of your hashtags pull the most engagement and suggests new ones.

  1. Scroll to the Hashtag Performance section.
  2. Review the top performers — copy them for future posts.
  3. Review the underperformers — consider dropping them.
  4. Browse the AI suggestions for new hashtags to try.

Exporting reports

For clients or your own records, you can export the analytics view as CSV or PDF.

  1. In the Analytics tab, look for the CSV and PDF buttons in the top-right.
  2. Click either. The file downloads immediately.
  3. The PDF includes metric summary, top posts, and engagement chart, ready to share.
SECTION 10

Managing settings

Platforms, templates, RSS sources, A/B tests, card style — all in one place.

The Settings tab has 6 sub-sections accessible from the pill row at the top.

Platforms

Shows all 4 supported platforms and which ones you've connected.

The Platforms sub-tab shows each platform's connection status and capabilities.
  1. Go to ⚙️ Settings → Platforms.
  2. Review each card. Green CONFIGURED badge means you're good. Red NOT CONFIGURED means setup needed.
  3. For platforms not yet connected, click Connect on the card — you'll be sent to that platform's authorization screen and back, securely connected in a few seconds.
  4. Connection status auto-refreshes every minute.

Templates

Save and reuse card/carousel configurations.

  1. Go to Settings → Templates.
  2. Click + New Template.
  3. Enter a name, description, and category (news, culture, anime, travel, food, general).
  4. Click Create. The template appears in the grid below.
  5. From any expanded card, you can apply a template to inherit its card and slide configuration.

RSS Sources

Add, remove, or toggle the feeds Kakoi scrapes from.

  1. Go to Settings → RSS Sources.
  2. Click + Add Source.
  3. Enter a feed name and the RSS URL. Pick a category (news, culture, anime, tech, food, travel).
  4. Click Add. The new source appears under its category.
  5. Toggle any source on/off without deleting it — useful for seasonal feeds.
  6. Click the trash icon to permanently remove a feed.

A/B Tests

Review all A/B tests you've created from PostCards, and pick winners.

  1. Go to Settings → A/B Tests.
  2. Each test shows Variant A and Variant B side-by-side.
  3. For pending tests, click Pick A, Pick B, or Tie.
  4. Evaluated tests display the winner with a green highlight.

Card Style

Configure the visual appearance of auto-generated card images: colors, fonts, logo, gradient.

  1. Go to Settings → Card Style.
  2. Upload your logo (PNG with transparency recommended).
  3. Pick gradient colors from the palette or enter hex values.
  4. Choose font and size. Preview updates live.
  5. Save. All future card generations use this style.

About

Version info, credits, links to documentation. Mostly informational.

SECTION 11

Common workflows

Recipes for the most common things creators want to do with Kakoi.

Recipe

Publish 3 posts to all 4 platforms before lunch

~10 min

The classic Kakoi flow — open the app, pick the day's posts, hit publish.

  1. Go to Content. Click Scrape RSS. Wait for results (~30s).
  2. Click the 3 highest-scored cards to expand them one at a time.
  3. For each card, quickly review the caption. Edit if needed.
  4. Toggle all 4 platform pills in the Publish to platforms row.
  5. Click 📤 Publish. Wait for the per-platform confirmations.
  6. Repeat for cards 2 and 3.
Recipe

Set up Autopilot for the first time

~15 min

From zero to "Kakoi is publishing on my behalf" with sensible defaults.

  1. Add 5-10 RSS feeds relevant to your niche in Settings → RSS Sources.
  2. Create a brand voice template in Settings → Templates. Describe your tone in 2-3 sentences.
  3. Run a manual scrape on Content. Review the AI-generated captions — are they on-brand?
  4. If not, adjust your brand voice template and run another manual scrape until you're happy.
  5. Go to Calendar → Autopilot panel. Set Max Posts/Day = 1, Min Score = 8, Interval = 6 hours, Auto-publish = OFF.
  6. Click Start. Let it run for 24 hours.
  7. Review the queued drafts after 24 hours. If good, switch Auto-publish to ON.
Recipe

Use Trends + URL→Post for a timely take

~5 min

When something just happened and you want to be in the conversation fast.

  1. Go to Trends. Find the topic you want to address.
  2. Open the source link referenced in the trend (Twitter, news article, etc.).
  3. Copy the URL of the most authoritative source covering this trend.
  4. Go to URL → Post. Paste the URL, click Generate.
  5. Review and lightly edit the caption to add your perspective.
  6. Click Publish. Done — you're in the conversation while it's still hot.
Recipe

Run an A/B test on your next launch

~3 min setup + 1 week waiting

Stop guessing which caption works. Run an actual test.

  1. Open the article you want to A/B test in Content or URL→Post.
  2. Click 🧪 A/B. Kakoi creates two caption variants.
  3. Schedule Variant A for Monday at your optimal posting time.
  4. Schedule Variant B for the next Monday, same time, same platforms.
  5. After both have run for a week, check Analytics to compare reach and engagement.
  6. Go to Settings → A/B Tests and click Pick A, Pick B, or Tie.
  7. Over time, you build a personal data set of what your audience actually responds to.
Recipe

Monthly client report from Analytics

~5 min

If you're managing accounts for clients, this is your end-of-month workflow.

  1. Go to Analytics.
  2. Pick the platform the client cares about (or All).
  3. Set date range to 30d.
  4. Click PDF in the top-right. Kakoi generates a multi-page report.
  5. Attach to your client email or include in your monthly deck.
SECTION 12

Troubleshooting & FAQ

The things creators usually ask, with concise answers.

I clicked Scrape RSS but nothing happened — what's wrong?

Check two things in order: (1) Is at least one RSS source enabled in Settings → RSS Sources? (2) Look at the top of the page for a yellow notice — if a connected social account is in error state, scraping may proceed but publishing will fail. If both look fine, try refreshing the browser.

The captions are too long for Threads. How do I shorten them automatically?

Click ✍️ Regenerate text on the expanded card — when Threads is in your selected platforms, Kakoi tries to keep the caption under 500 characters. If it still goes over, click ✏️ Edit and shorten manually. Kakoi will try a different generation approach if you regenerate again.

Why does TikTok say "Drafts only"?

TikTok's developer policy gates auto-publish behind an app review process that takes weeks. Until that's approved, Kakoi pushes posts as drafts to your TikTok app. You'll get a notification on your phone, then tap to finish publishing.

Autopilot published a weird post. How do I delete it?

Each published post shows up in the Content tab with a "Published" badge. Click to expand it, then look for the 🗑️ Delete button in the toolbar. This removes it from the platform and from Kakoi's history. Adjust your min score or RSS sources to reduce the chance of recurrence.

The brand voice score keeps being low. What do I do?

Check Settings → Templates for your brand voice description. If it's too vague ("friendly"), the LLM has nothing to enforce. Rewrite it to be specific: "Conversational, no corporate jargon. Sentences under 15 words. One emoji per caption. Address the reader as 'you'." Specific rules → consistent scores.

The image editor isn't loading. Is my browser supported?

The image editor uses HTML canvas — works in any modern browser. If it's blank, try a hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac, Ctrl+F5 on Windows). If still blank, check the browser console for errors and report them.

Can I run multiple Instagram accounts from one Kakoi install?

Currently Kakoi is single-account per platform. To run multiple Instagram accounts, run multiple Kakoi instances. Multi-account/team features are on the roadmap.

My analytics numbers don't match what I see in the Instagram app. Why?

Two possible reasons: (1) Kakoi caches analytics for 6 hours. Click Refresh in the top-right to force-pull fresh data. (2) Instagram's own dashboard sometimes lags by 12-48 hours. After both refreshes, the numbers should align.

How do I back up my data?

Your data lives in a single file (the Kakoi database) on your machine. Back it up like any other file — copy it to Dropbox/iCloud/wherever. Restoring is just copying it back.
